Description:
[size=5]To all my friends who love plants.[/size]

[size=4]This tropical plant furniture collection includes a total of [/size][b]39[/b][size=4] plant species, such as [/size][b][i][u]begonias, monsteras, alocasias, anthuriums[/u][/i][/b][size=4], and all kinds of tropical plants I absolutely love.[/size]

[size=5]After downloading, you can find these tropical plant pots at [b]Robin's shop[/b] or in the [b]furniture catalog[/b].[/size]
